66:1: O Prophet! Why do you make forbidden what Allah has made lawful for you? Are you seeking the pleasure of your wives? Allah is very forgiving, very merciful.
66:2: Allah has made obligatory for you the dissolution of your oaths, and Allah is your Mawla, and He is the Knower, the Possessor of wisdom.
66:3: When the Prophet spoke a word secretly to one of his wives, she reported it, and Allah made it known to him. The Prophet disclosed a part of it and turned away from a part. When he informed her of this, she said: Who informed you of this? He said: The One who knows everything, who is aware of everything informed me.
66:4: If you two repent to Allah, your hearts have indeed inclined; and if you back each other up against him, surely Allah is his helper, and Gabriel, and the righteous among the believers, and the angels moreover are supporters.
66:5: Perhaps his Rabb, if he divorces you, will give him in exchange wives better than you: Muslim, believing, obedient, repenting, worshipping, fasting, widows and virgins.
66:6: O you who believe, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones; over it are harsh, severe angels, who do not rebel against what Allah commands them and do what they are commanded.
66:7: O you who disbelieve, do not make excuses today; you are only seeing the recompense of what you did, it is said.
66:8: O you who believe! Repent to Allah with a sincere repentance, so that your Rabb may cover your evil deeds and put you into gardens beneath which rivers flow. On that Day, Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light runs before them and on their right sides. They say: Our Rabb, complete our light for us and forgive us. Surely You are Powerful over all things.
66:9: O Prophet! Strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be harsh against them. Their shelter is Hell, and what an evil destination it is!
66:10: Allah set forth as an example for those who disbelieve the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were both under the marriage of two righteous servants from among Our servants. Then they betrayed them, and they provided nothing for them against Allah. And it was said: 'Enter the Fire along with those who enter.'
66:11: Allah also set forth as an example for those who believe the wife of Pharaoh. When she said: Rabb! Build for me a house near You, in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his deed, and save me from the people of the wrongdoers.
66:12: And Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her from Our spirit, and she confirmed the words of her Rabb and His books, and she was of the obedient.
